chapters.title: Chapter 1: Ancient Greece
chapters.description: A war of epic proportions rages through ancient Greece both by sea and land. Amid the chaos, Lex must find his way off the battlegrounds and to safety. Your quest begins!

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Island of the Cyclopes
chapters.description: Fleeing from the tumultuous lands to the north, Lex finds himself washed ashore upon an unforgiving rocky isle. Before Lex lies the land of one-eyed giants and adventure!

chapters.title: Chapter 3: The Wandering Rocks
chapters.description: Having defeated the Cyclopes, Lex sets sail in search of Cassandra and is beset by storms, sirens and spirits of the sea. Will you survive Poseidon's wrath?

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Isle of Circe
chapters.description: Narrowly surviving the trials of the angry sea god, Lex finds himself shipwrecked on an enchanted isle lush with life. It is said that Circe's enchanted beasts strike with unusual force!

chapters.title: Chapter 5: The Underworld
chapters.description: Circe tells of a blacksmith deep in the Underworld named Hephaestus who can forge gems into powerful new letter tiles! Circe warns that your tiles will come under attack!

chapters.title: Chapter 6: Labyrinth of Crete
chapters.description: Emerging safely and with new powers, Lex feels stronger than ever. Before Lex lies the Minotaur Labyrinth. Within the maze await especially poisonous and stunning foes.

chapters.title: Chapter 7: Lernean Swamp
chapters.description: Lex's next challenge is the legendary 7-headed Hydra of Lernea, each head more fearsome than the one before! There will be no rest between each head, so be wary!

chapters.title: Chapter 8: Nemean Forest
chapters.description: Just beyond lies the forbidden forest of Nemea, home to many a beast even the mighty Hercules fears. However, these beasts are weak to special categories of words.

chapters.title: Chapter 9: River Evenus
chapters.description: Only the Evenus River area and its centaur guardian Nessus stand between Lex and Cassandra. He and his minions employ the powers of poison, plague and nature!

chapters.title: Chapter 10: Delphi
chapters.description: All around you stand grand statues of warriors and beasts. Cassandra is imprisoned deep in the temple. One would be wise to prepare for the denizens' many petrifying attacks.

chapters.title: Chapter 1: Port of Alexandria
chapters.description: Lex begins his search for the magical weapon of awesome power in this populated and dangerous city port.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Lex Baba and the 14 Thieves
chapters.description: Promised knowledge of the weapon's location, Lex fights Maladin's enemies deep in a cave vault.

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Tomb of the Ancients
chapters.description: Abandoned by Maladin, Lex stumbles through a cursed Egyptian tomb.

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Riddle of the Sphinx
chapters.description: Making good with the Pharaoh's ghost, Lex faces yet another barrier, the riddles of the Sphinx.

chapters.title: Chapter 5: Thar be Pirates!
chapters.description: Lex sets sail aboard Sinbad's ship, only to be boarded by a crew of angry pirates!

chapters.title: Chapter 6: Island of Immensity
chapters.description: Washed ashore after the pirates destroy the ship, Lex must battle animals of unusual size in an attempt to find a way back to civilization.

chapters.title: Chapter 7: Mirage Mania
chapters.description: Discarded deep in the Arabian Desert, Lex goes mad, battling apparitions and mirages.

chapters.title: Chapter 8: Crazy Murray's Bizarre Bazaar
chapters.description: Making his way across the desert, Lex comes upon a luxurious tent and a familiar face.

chapters.title: Chapter 9: Genies, Genies, Genies
chapters.description: Lex takes hold of the Genie Lamp and unwittingly lets loose an army of genies who do not bow to his will easily.

chapters.title: Chapter 10: The Palace
chapters.description: Finally besting the genies of the lamp, Lex is teleported to Scheherazade's Palace where its denizens suffer him one final round of grief before his questions are answered.

chapters.title: Chapter 1: Ravaged Countryside
chapters.description: Misunderstood as an evil monster by the local townsfolk and town militia, Lex must escape before being burned at the stake!

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Highway to Heck
chapters.description: In the distance Lex sees a castle's tower. The path that leads there, however, is not easy...

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Light in Frankenstein's House
chapters.description: Having battled through the sickness of the Highway to Heck, Lex enters the mysterious castle...

chapters.title: Chapter 4: The Haunt
chapters.description: Following the good doctor's advice, Lex steels his courage and wiggles under the darkened boughs of the fell forest known only as The Haunt.

chapters.title: Chapter 5: The Quagmire
chapters.description: Lex travels into even darker and more hostile lands. Losing hope and feeling desperately lost, Lex's morale is shaken.

chapters.title: Chapter 6: Graveyard of Lost Hopes
chapters.description: Haunted by the swamp creature's foretelling of doom, Lex battles forward to see for himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 7: Tomb of Heroes
chapters.description: Driven to despair by Grim's omen, Lex loses faith and wanders aimlessly into a dark tomb.

chapters.title: Chapter 8: Army of Darkitude
chapters.description: Pointed at last in the right direction by the Fallen Heroes, Lex makes one last push onward to dread Dracula's domain!

chapters.title: Chapter 9: Dracula's Castle
chapters.description: Finally in the correct tower, Lex pulls out all the stops for a definitive beat-down of evil!

chapters.title: Chapter 10: The Great Library
chapters.description: Lex learns the truth and it's more horrible than he ever imagined. Can anyone survive?

AegisOfAthena.name: Aegis of Athena
AegisOfAthena.lore: Negates a full heart of damage when Lex is attacked.

ArchOfApollo.name: Arch of Xyzzy
ArchOfApollo.lore: Greatly boosts words using X, Y or Z.

ArtemisBow.name: Bow of Zyx
ArtemisBow.lore: Boosts words using the letters X, Y or Z.

GoldenFleece.name: Golden Fleece
GoldenFleece.lore: Temporarily grants Lex a full extra heart of health.

GorgonHead.name: Medusa Bust
GorgonHead.lore: Adds a chance to resist petrify and power down.

HandOfHercules.name: Hand of Hercules
HandOfHercules.lore: Lex's attacks cause an extra full heart of damage. Spell 'metal' words for even more!

HephaestusHammer.name: Heph's Hammer
HephaestusHammer.lore: Each of Lex's attacks causes an extra half a heart of damage.

HopeOfQua.name: Quadrumvir Signet
HopeOfQua.lore: Spell words containing 'QUA' for bonus damage and purify.

ImmortalWrappings.name: Immortal Wrappings
ImmortalWrappings.lore: Greatly resists tile smash and lock.

MagicGenieLamp.name: Genie Lamp
MagicGenieLamp.lore: Boosts effects of healing and power up potions.

PoseidonsShield.name: Poseidon's Shield
PoseidonsShield.lore: Negates half of a heart of damage each time Lex's enemies attack.

RobeOfTheShiftingEye.name: Robe of the Unseen
RobeOfTheShiftingEye.lore: Chance to resist poison and fire.

SlayerTalisman.name: Slayer Talisman
SlayerTalisman.lore: Spell 'mammal' words for extra damage and bleed.

TabletOfTheAges.name: Tablet of the Ages
TabletOfTheAges.lore: Bonus damage for 'color' words and heals Lex.
